purpose: Component attribution of ROE improvement without parameter optimization.

fixed_variants.delevered_roe: ROE residual after removing the equity multiplier
fixed_variants.negative_roe_volatility: Negative volatility of the latest nine TTM ROE observations
fixed_variants.stable_delevered_roe: Equal-weighted combination of delevered ROE and negative ROE volatility

common_treatment: All variants use the same MAD winsorization, CITIC 2019 first-level industry neutralization, log-market-cap neutralization, and cross-sectional z-score.
